name: pixonaut-shop
description: WooCommerce block theme for stores that sell personalised products through Pixonaut for WooCommerce

scripts.dev: pnpm env:start && pnpm env:activate && pnpm start
scripts.env:cli: cross-env WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env-home wp-env run cli wp
scripts.env:activate: cross-env WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env-home wp-env run cli wp theme activate pixonaut-shop && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/plugin/activate-cli.ts
scripts.env:activate-tests: cross-env WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env-home wp-env run tests-cli wp theme activate pixonaut-shop
scripts.wp-cli: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app -u "$(scripts/docker/host-user.sh)" -e HOME=/tmp -e WP_CLI_ALLOW_ROOT=1 wordpress:cli-php8.4 wp
scripts.test:integration: cross-env WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env-home sh -c 'wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/themes/pixonaut-shop vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist -- "$@"' sh
scripts.i18n:pot: pnpm build && pnpm wp-cli i18n make-pot . languages/pixonaut-shop.pot --slug=pixonaut-shop --domain=pixonaut-shop --exclude=node_modules,vendor,src,tests,docs,scripts
scripts.i18n:update: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app alpine:3 sh -c "apk add --no-cache gettext >/dev/null && msgmerge --update --backup=none languages/sv_SE.po languages/pixonaut-shop.pot && msgattrib --no-obsolete -o languages/sv_SE.po languages/sv_SE.po && chown $(scripts/docker/host-user.sh) languages/sv_SE.po"
scripts.i18n:mo: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app alpine:3 sh -c "apk add --no-cache gettext >/dev/null && msgfmt -o languages/sv_SE.mo languages/sv_SE.po && chown $(scripts/docker/host-user.sh) languages/sv_SE.mo" && pnpm wp-cli i18n make-json languages --no-purge
scripts.i18n: pnpm i18n:pot && pnpm i18n:update && pnpm i18n:mo
